description.value:
When a creature you can see casts a tech power of a level you could cast, you may use your reaction to try copying it into your wristpad, making an ability check with your techcasting ability (with proficiency) against a DC of 10 plus twice the power's level. Success stores the power for later use; failure stores nothing. Powers stored this way can be cast as though you'd learned them, and they don't count against your tech powers known.

You can't use this feature again on the same creature until you complete a short or long rest. At any time you can hold a combined number of power levels equal to your engineer level, and each time you use this feature you may also swap out or drop one or more previously stored powers.
